chunks: So, when Our command (of punishment) came We delivered Saleh by Our grace, and those who believed, with him, from the disgrace of that day. Verily your Lord is mighty and powerful.
ai.seo_question: How did God save Saleh and the believers from the disgrace of the day of punishment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of divine mercy (rahmah) as the active force preserving the faithful from the humiliation (khizy) of the Day of Judgment, distinguishing them from the disbelievers. It reinforces the theological principle that salvation is contingent upon both belief and divine grace, with God’s might (al-Qawi) ensuring the efficacy of His decree. The mention of 'those who believed with him' highlights the communal aspect of faith in the narrative of the Prophet Saleh.
